Good afternoon.
How can I help you?
Hi.
I checked in yesterday.
My room key card was working just fine then, but when I tried it just now, I couldn't get in.
Hmm.
Sometimes the magnetic strip on the key card stops working.
Let me get my manager.
She'll be able to help you.
Hi.
I'm Isabel.
I understand your room key isn't working.
I just need your room number to provide you with a replacement.
I'm in room 639.
All right.
Now this new key should work for you.
And for the inconvenience, please accept this coupon for the hotel restaurant.
You'll receive 10% off a meal there.
